text: Edam is made from partially skimmed milk, so it has 40–44% fat in dry matter against 48–52% for Gouda Holland. The Noord-Hollandse Edammer is moulded as a small sphere with flat top and bottom.

steps.note: The curd is moulded as a sphere with flat ends, 1.7–1.9 kg.
Baby Edam is ripened for at least 21 days.
